digest.component_or_area: MCP error handling and CLI/library error code standardization
propositions: MCP tool failures currently return prose-only exceptions or ad-hoc partial shapes without the structured error discriminator that the CLI emits via error_envelope

The CLI scatters error code literals across 12 call sites without a centralized vocabulary source, making it impossible to verify that MCP and library interfaces can emit identical codes for the same failure
The library raises RebarError/ConcurrencyError/TicketNotFoundError/CommandError without exposing a machine error code uniformly, blocking a cross-interface test that verifies all three surfaces agree

MCP must emit error_envelope with machine-readable error code on every failure (exception-raised or returned), preserving existing agent-branching fields (kind, resolution_class, retryable) without information loss

A new central classifier error_code_for(exc)->str and frozenset KNOWN_ERROR_CODES must be the single source of truth for error codes, used by CLI (regression test), library (re-export), and MCP (guard wrapper)

TicketNotFoundError must be raised at the two genuine not-found sites in reads.py with the same message, leaving the deps reader path unchanged so CLI message-keyed logic produces byte-identical output
